confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or current menus. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is less certain and reflects July southwest-monsoon low season on the south coast. Cocktail and wine were derived from the local beer price, since direct knowledge of bar prices is weak: cocktail is about 1.4x beer and wine glass about 2x beer, reflecting Sri Lankan alcohol taxes. FX value came from search-result snippets citing the RBA overview page (0.6955 as at 4pm, 15 October 2026); the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Sri Lankan south-coast beach resort towns (Weligama, Unawatuna) and Galle-area guesthouses, using July off-season accommodation pricing and tourist-area restaurant pricing. No single comparable city was used.
